idiot.en: He even called me an idiot.

ignore.en: It wouldn't be wise to ignore Tom completely.
ignore.zh: 完全忽视汤姆不会是明智的。

impossible.en: It's impossible to do the sights of Tokyo in a day or two.
impossible.zh: 一两天是没办法逛完东京的。

ignorance.en: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.
ignorance.zh: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。

insane.en: He behaves as if he were insane.

illness.en: We take health for granted until illness intervenes.
illness.zh: 我们视健康为理所当然, 直到疾病侵袭。

income.en: His large income enables him to travel abroad every year.
income.zh: 他的收入很高，所以每年都能出国旅行。

intend.en: I intend to visit Australia during my spring break.
intend.zh: 我打算在春假的时候去参观澳洲。

indispensable.zh: 水是生命所不可缺少的。

imagination.en: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
imagination.zh: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。

interview.en: You'll have to play it by ear at the interview.
interview.zh: 在面试的时候你必须见机行事。

inspiration.en: After climbing Mt. Fuji, I got the inspiration for a poem.
inspiration.zh: 攀登富士山后，我得到了一首诗的灵感。

intent.en: The only difference between a bad cook and a poisoner is the intent.
intent.zh: 一个差劲的厨师和下毒者唯一的不同在于他们的意图。

ink.en: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.
ink.zh: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。

iron.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
iron.zh: 先熨烫领子的里面，然后是外面。

intention.en: Tom has no intention of asking Mary to the upcoming dance.
intention.zh: Tom没有意图去邀请Mary去即将来临的舞会。

introduce.en: I think the time is right to introduce this product.
introduce.zh: 我觉得现在是发表这个产品的好时机。

indian.en: Taiwanese food is milder than Indian food.
indian.zh: 台湾菜比印度菜口味淡。

intelligent.en: He is not as intelligent as his older brother.
intelligent.zh: 他不像他的兄长那样聪明。

ignorant.en: I am quite ignorant of their plan.
ignorant.zh: 他们的计划我一无所知。

interest.en: Banks charge higher interest on loans to risky customers.
interest.zh: 银行对风险客户收取较高的贷款利息。

inside.en: Iron the inside of collars first, and then the outside.
inside.zh: 先熨烫领子的里面，然后是外面。

innocent.en: If he is innocent, it follows that his wife is guilty.
innocent.zh: 如果他是清白的，那他妻子就有罪。

india.en: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.
india.zh: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。

interrupt.en: I didn't mean to interrupt anything.

immediately.en: Immediately after it caught fire, the chemical factory blew up.
immediately.zh: 化学工厂一着火就爆炸了。

imply.en: I didn't mean to imply otherwise.

interfere.en: You have no right to interfere in other people's affairs.
interfere.zh: 你没有干涉他人事务的权力。

instantly.en: Tom was hit by a truck and died instantly.
instantly.zh: 汤姆被卡车撞到而且当场死亡。

invaluable.en: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
invaluable.zh: 互联网是一种无法估量的信息资源。

involve.en: I didn't mean to involve you.
involve.zh: 我没想要让你牵扯进来。

industry.en: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
industry.zh: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。

infectious.zh: 汤姆的笑声很有感染力。

insurance.en: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
insurance.zh: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

incident.en: The incident made everyone feel more embarrassed.
incident.zh: 这件事弄得大家都比较尴尬。

island.en: The economy of the island is dependent on the fishing industry.
island.zh: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。

insist.en: They insist that he should go.

italian.en: One is Japanese and the other is Italian.
italian.zh: 一个是日本人，另一个是意大利人。

issue.en: How do you feel about the issue?
issue.zh: 你对这个问题有甚么感受？

insult.en: Tom didn't mean to insult anybody.

intersection.en: Turn right at the next intersection.
intersection.zh: 请在下一个十字路口右转。

imaginative.en: He used to be an imaginative boy.
imaginative.zh: 他曾经是一个富有想像力的男孩。

injection.en: I need to give you an injection.

intelligence.en: To have doubts about oneself is the first sign of intelligence.
intelligence.zh: 自我怀疑是聪明的第一标志。

impatient.en: Tom told me he thought Mary would be impatient.
impatient.zh: 汤姆告诉我，他以为玛莉会有耐心。

instrument.en: Do you play any instrument other than the piano?
instrument.zh: 除了钢琴以外，还会玩什么乐器吗？

independent.en: He is independent of his parents.

ideal.en: The beach is an ideal place for children to play.
ideal.zh: 海滩是一个供孩子们玩乐的理想场所。

imagine.en: I imagine that you are wondering when your new PC will arrive.
imagine.zh: 我猜您一定想知道您的新电脑什么时候到货。

indoors.en: When I was a child, I spent most of my time indoors reading.
indoors.zh: 当我是个孩子的时候，我会把大部分时间都用于室内阅读。

interpreter.en: My uncle made me serve as interpreter.

inform.en: We should inform them about that.
inform.zh: 我们应该把那件事情告知他们。

imitate.en: Parrots can imitate the human voice.

impulse.en: He told his wife not to buy on impulse.
impulse.zh: 他叫自己的妻子不要冲动购物。

international.en: In a few minutes we'll be landing at New Tokyo International Airport.
international.zh: 我们将于几分钟内降落在新东京国际机场。

internet.en: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
internet.zh: 互联网是一种无法估量的信息资源。

illegal.en: In Canada, there are many areas where it is illegal to log trees.
illegal.zh: 在加拿大有很多区域砍伐树木是非法的。

include.en: The price does not include the box.
include.zh: 这个价格不包含这个箱子。

indeed.en: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

improve.en: She took full advantage of her stay in London to improve her English.
improve.zh: 她充分利用她住在伦敦的优势，提高英语。

invite.en: I'd like to invite you to the party.

industrial.en: Many people work in industrial towns.
industrial.zh: 许多人在工业城市工作。

increase.en: If you feed your dog properly, you can increase his lifespan.
increase.zh: 合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。

investment.en: They obtained a yield of 8 percent on their investment.
investment.zh: 他们在这次的投资中得到百分之八的收益。

irregular.en: I don't like learning irregular verbs.
irregular.zh: 我不喜欢学习不规则动词。

impression.en: You never get a second chance to make a first impression.
impression.zh: 你永远没有第二次机会去打造第一印象。

importance.en: This is considered to be a matter of great importance.

item.en: The first item he bought was an alarm clock.
item.zh: 他买的第一项东西是一个闹钟。

inch.en: Give him an inch and he'll take a yard.

inflation.en: Interest rates and inflation were high.

instant.en: Right at that instant, the bus stopped.
instant.zh: 就在那时，公交车停住了。

indicate.en: Smiles do not always indicate pleasure.
indicate.zh: 微笑并不一定表示高兴。

imperative.en: It is imperative for you to act at once.

insect.en: What do you call this insect in English?
insect.zh: 这种昆虫在英语中叫什么？

improvement.en: Your essay still needs some improvement.

immune.en: Everybody is immune to smallpox nowadays.
immune.zh: 现今每个人都对天花免疫了。

imaginary.en: Some scientists believe that the greenhouse effect is imaginary.
imaginary.zh: 有的科学家认为温室效应是虚构的。

injury.en: Not all of the passengers escaped injury.
injury.zh: 并非所有的乘客都免于受伤。

install.en: The man tried to install his own antenna.
install.zh: 这男人试着安装他自己的天线。

influence.en: It was through his influence that she became interested in ecology.
influence.zh: 她开始对生态学感兴趣，是受到他的影响。

identification.en: Do you have your student identification card?

invention.en: The washing machine is a wonderful invention.
invention.zh: 洗衣机是一个很棒的发明。

insufficient.en: There is insufficient light to take pictures.

influential.en: He is very influential in the world of medicine.
influential.zh: 他在医学界有很大的影响力。

independence.en: India gained independence from Britain in 1947.
independence.zh: 印度于1947年脱离英国获得独立。

inner.en: Politicians never tell us their inner thoughts.
inner.zh: 政治家从来不告诉我们他们的别有用心。

inspect.en: Sir, can we quickly inspect your luggage please?
inspect.zh: 先生，我们可以检查一下您的行李吗？

inn.en: A fire broke out at the inn where they were staying.
inn.zh: 火警发生在他们住的旅馆。

invisible.en: If I were invisible, I wouldn't have to wear anything.
invisible.zh: 若我是隐形的，就不用穿衣服了。

indifferent.en: Lots of people in Japan are indifferent to politics.
indifferent.zh: 很多日本人对政治冷淡。

instructor.en: My driving instructor says I should be more patient.
instructor.zh: 我的驾驶教练说我应该更有耐心一点。

imperial.en: Meet me at the lobby of the Imperial Hotel at 6:30 p.m.
imperial.zh: 下午六点半到帝国酒店的大堂找我。

invest.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
invest.zh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。

impressive.en: You've both been very impressive today. I'm proud of you.
impressive.zh: 今天你们俩很让人印象深刻。我为你们感到骄傲。

icy.en: Many accidents resulted from the icy conditions of the road.
icy.zh: 道路结冰导致了很多起事故。

image.en: What image did you have in mind as you painted this picture?
image.zh: 画这幅画的时候你脑海中浮现出了什么图像？

islam.en: Islam first reached China about the middle of the 7th century.
islam.zh: 伊斯兰教大约在七世纪中传到中国。

injure.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
injure.zh: 如果你不按照安全手续来的话，你可能会受伤的。

investigate.en: He announced that he would come at once and investigate the matter.
investigate.zh: 他宣布他将立刻来调查此事。
